# Amit Bhardwaj

> Certified Salesforce Architect & Developer · Systems Engineer · AI Automation Specialist

## Manifesto

> Systems should not just work—they must scale, self-heal, and integrate seamlessly.

Amit Bhardwaj is a London-based Certified Salesforce Technical Architect and Systems Engineer with 19+ years of hands-on experience. His career began in 2007 building bare-metal Linux servers, DNS zones, mail servers, and DHCP infrastructure at Directi. He has since delivered 100+ enterprise Salesforce projects across Sales, Service, Experience, and Financial Services Clouds — designing zero-trust security architectures, event-driven SAP integrations, and AI-native automation workflows.

## Projects & Deep Dives

### VisionVox AI Companion
- **Type:** Accessibility Voice & Vision Companion
- **Focus:** Low-latency vision descriptions using the Gemini Live API over WebSockets, with proactive safety warnings and real-time OCR text-to-speech.

### Salesforce DX AI Copilot
- **Type:** Agentic Developer Tool
- **Focus:** Writes test classes, generates packages, runs code analyses, and automates DevOps pipelines.

### GitProtect Security Gate
- **Type:** Commit & PR Scanning Pipeline
- **Focus:** Automated security scanning pipeline that intercepts credential leaks and private certificates in version control before staging, with model-graded security analysis.

### Secure Experience Cloud Portal
- **Type:** Salesforce Security Architecture
- **Focus:** Designed a high-security Salesforce Experience Cloud portal for a regulatory financial redress program. Custom passwordless login validating encrypted customer attributes, rate-limiting, brute-force prevention, and full audit trails — serving millions under strict FCA compliance.

### MCP Enterprise Framework
- **Type:** AI Developer Tooling
- **Focus:** Model Context Protocol integration enabling AI coding assistants to securely access local databases, git history, and project schemas with sandbox isolation.

### Home Lab Infrastructure
- **Type:** DevOps & Infrastructure Lab
- **Focus:** A fully self-hosted Proxmox virtualized environment used for exploring VLAN configurations, OpenWrt customized routing, and real-time monitoring.

### Enterprise Integration Architecture
- **Type:** Salesforce ↔ SAP Integration
- **Focus:** Decoupled, event-driven architecture connecting Salesforce CRM with enterprise SAP ERP backends.

### HCL Technologies (2019 - 2024)
- **Role:** Developer & Support Engineer
- **Focus:** Pivotal Salesforce learning milestone — Apex development, Tier-2/3 production support, environment stabilization, and progressive growth into trusted technical advisor.

### Infomatrix (2013 - 2019)
- **Role:** Salesforce Practice Lead
- **Focus:** Technical design leadership, Apex/LWC development, platform security audits, and API integration architectures.

### Directi (2009 - 2010)
- **Role:** Linux System Administrator
- **Focus:** Server hardening (CentOS, RedHat, Debian), Apache web servers, BIND DNS zones, Postfix/Exim mail servers, DHCP administration, and 99.9% uptime.

### Spectrum Infogain Services (2007 - 2009)
- **Role:** System Engineer
- **Focus:** Hardware diagnostics, motherboard recovery, OS provisioning, RAID configuration, and network setup — foundational bare-metal systems engineering.
